items.status: independently recomputed
items.scope: SPLINCE side recomputed from per-cell stored metrics (not from representations). SPLINCE is an in-house reimplementation of Holstege et al. Thm 1 (pcrl/baselines/splince.py), fit per (purpose, ONE attribute, seed) - each cell erases only the audited attribute, whereas PCRL's h_p must satisfy all of the purpose's attributes at once. Its input is NOT 'pre-LEACE features': R5/R7 code has no separate LEACE buffer (set_leace_projection added in 940912cb9, after R7), the LEACE map is folded into the trained LoRA, so SPLINCE post-processes PCRL's own final.pt h_p (already constrained/collapsed; pre-projection per_dim_std 0.22-0.58). Health threshold is scale dependent: one SPLINCE cell has per_dim_std 968.
